text: {"sql": "SELECT agv_id, shift_code, COUNT(*) AS total_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'aborted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aborted_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'late' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_tasks, ROUND(AVG(delay_s), 1) AS avg_delay_s FROM sf_fleet.agv_tasks GROUP BY agv_id, shift_code ORDER BY (SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'aborted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'late' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) DESC, agv_id ASC, shift_code ASC LIMIT 20", "columns": ["agv_id", "shift_code", "total_tasks", "aborted_tasks", "late_tasks", "avg_delay_s"], "purpose": "Identify which AGV fails most and in which shift by total, aborted, late tasks and average delay"}

data.sql: SELECT agv_id, shift_code, COUNT(*) AS total_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'aborted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aborted_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'late' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_tasks, ROUND(AVG(delay_s), 1) AS avg_delay_s FROM sf_fleet.agv_tasks GROUP BY agv_id, shift_code ORDER BY (SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'aborted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'late' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) DESC, agv_id ASC, shift_code ASC LIMIT 20
data.purpose: Identify which AGV fails most and in which shift by total, aborted, late tasks and average delay
